observed.caption: A dramatic cloudy sky over a green hilltop lined with wind turbines, framed by trees in the foreground.
observed.description: In the left foreground a tall leaning tree with dense green foliage and a curved trunk is visible, with additional trees and shrubs on the right foreground. In the middle and background a green vegetated hill ridge stretches across the horizon with several wind turbines silhouetted along its crest. Above the hill a large mass of bright white and gray cumulus clouds dominates the sky, with a small patch of blue sky visible on the far right. Below the hill a valley with scattered trees and vegetation is visible under natural daylight.
